steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—typically a degree plus years leading projects, or equivalent experience without a degree. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you assess whether you meet the criteria before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend all sessions synchronously from anywhere, interact with active certified practitioners, and cover the full PMBOK® Guide curriculum. Our Portland professionals often balance training with work schedules—we offer flexible session times to fit your calendar.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once you finish the required contact hours, apply directly to PMI for exam eligibility. Submit your education and experience details, and pay PMI's exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process so you avoid delays and move forward confidently.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours—to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. Our support continues right up to test day so you enter the exam ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, maintain your credential by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) over PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible workshops and courses to help you stay current and renew without interruption.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
